title: A Letter About a Job
text:
Dear Mr. Lewis, I am writing to ask about the job of office assistant. I saw the advertisement in the newspaper last week. I have three years of experience in an office and I speak good English. Please find my CV attached to this letter.

I would be happy to come to an interview on any weekday after 10 a.m. Please tell me which day is good for you. Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

questions.text: Where did the writer see the job advertisement?
What time can the writer come to an interview?
What can the reader infer about the writer's work history?
options: The writer has no work experience
The writer has worked in an office before
The writer has never used English

questions.text: Why does the writer attach a CV to the letter?
options: To ask for a higher salary
To show their qualifications for the job
To invite the reader to lunch

vocabulary.definition: a public notice that promotes a job, product or service
knowledge or skill gained from doing a job over time
sent with something else, such as a document sent with a letter
a meeting where an employer asks a candidate questions about a job

paragraph_translations: Sayın Bay Lewis, ofis asistanı işi hakkında bilgi almak için yazıyorum. Geçen hafta gazetedeki ilanı gördüm. Bir ofiste üç yıllık deneyimim var ve iyi İngilizce konuşuyorum. Lütfen özgeçmişimi bu mektuba ekli olarak bulun.

Herhangi bir hafta içi günü saat 10'dan sonra mülakata gelmekten memnuniyet duyarım. Lütfen hangi günün sizin için uygun olduğunu bana bildirin. Zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederim. Sizden haber almayı dört gözle bekliyorum.
